positions.name: The National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia
Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company
Umm Al Qura for Development and Construction Company
Jahez International Company for Information Systems Technology
Saudi Pharmaceutical Industries and Medical Appliances Corporation
Middle East Company for Manufacturing and Producing Paper
Al Rajhi Company for Cooperative Insurance
The Mediterranean and Gulf Cooperative Insurance and Reinsurance Company

config:
asset_classes:
- equity
equity:
  market: SA
  factor: dividend
  neutral: neutral
  weighting: invvol
  tier: 3
  shortable: false
universe_filters:
- type: HistoryFilter
  params:
    min_days: 252
- type: DataIntegrityFilter
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: adv_usd
    min_value: 2000000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: raw_close
    min_value: 5.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: mcap_usd
    min_value: 100000000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: TradedDaysFilter
  params:
    min_share: 0.9
    lookback: 63
- type: OneClassPerIssuer
- type: ShortableFilter
  params:
    mode: passthrough
vol_normalizer:
  type: Identity
signals:
- type: CrossSectionalSignal
  weight: 1.0
  params:
    indicator:
      type: PanelCharacteristic
      params:
        panel: div_yield
        sign: 1
        winsor: 0.01
    ranker:
      type: GroupNeutralRank
      params:
        inner:
          type: PercentileRank
          params:
            min_names: 5
        min_group_size: 5
        min_names: 40
    position_function:
      type: GroupNeutralQuantilePortfolio
      params:
        long_pct: 0.3
        short_pct: 0.3
        weighting: equal
        max_weight: 0.05
        cap_method: redistribute
        min_group_size: 5
        group_weight: names
    vol_estimator:
      type: EWMA2
      params:
        span: 63
    risk_weighting:
      type: InverseVol
      params:
        target_vol: 0.15
        floor: 0.08
        dollar_neutral: true
        group_neutral: true
        max_weight: 0.05
asset_allocator:
  type: Identity
model_gearing:
  type: XSVolTarget
  params:
    target_vol: 0.1
    vol_lookback: 126
    leverage_cap: 5.0
    buffer: 0.1
cost_model:
  type: EquityCosts
  params:
    market: SA
rebalance: monthly
position_smoothing: 10
smoothing_method: sma
group_level: sector
